Exceeds Expectations.description: Student asks questions that challenge the assumptions of a model or theory, seeking to identify its limits or propose a more refined, testable hypothesis. Defines a design problem with multiple, interacting constraints.

Meets Expectations.description: Student asks questions to determine the quantitative relationships between independent and dependent variables. Defines a design problem that involves a system with interacting components.

Approaching.description: Student asks questions to clarify a model or the relationship between variables in a physical system. Defines a design problem that includes multiple criteria and constraints.

Developing.description: Student asks questions to identify or clarify evidence and determine the relationship between variables in an investigation.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student designs a test of a physical model to ascertain its reliability and limitations, using the results to propose specific revisions. Develops a model to generate data that can solve a novel problem.

Meets Expectations.description: Student develops and uses a model (e.g., free-body diagram, ray diagram) based on evidence to illustrate or predict the relationships between components of a system.

Approaching.description: Student develops or modifies a model to show the relationships among variables, including those that are not directly observable.

Developing.description: Student develops a model using an analogy or abstract representation to describe a scientific principle.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student designs an investigation that considers and controls for confounding variables, and makes a directional hypothesis that is quantitatively testable.

Meets Expectations.description: Student plans an investigation to produce data that can serve as the basis for a model or explanation, selecting appropriate tools and controlling variables.

Approaching.description: Student plans an investigation that identifies independent and dependent variables and controls, and specifies how measurements will be recorded.

Developing.description: Student conducts a fair test, identifying the key variables and proposing a logical series of steps to gather data.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student applies concepts of statistics and probability to account for measurement error and determines the best functional fit for a data set to make a valid claim.

Meets Expectations.description: Student analyzes data using tools or models to make a valid and reliable scientific claim, determining the slope, intercept, and correlation for linear fits.

Approaching.description: Student constructs and analyzes graphical displays of data to identify linear and non-linear relationships.

Developing.description: Student uses graphical displays of data to identify temporal and spatial relationships.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student uses limit cases or algorithmic thinking to test the validity of a mathematical expression or computer program to see if it makes sense in the real world.

Meets Expectations.description: Student applies techniques of algebra and functions to represent and solve a scientific or engineering problem.

Approaching.description: Student uses mathematical representations (e.g., ratio, rate, percent, basic algebra) to describe and support a scientific conclusion.

Developing.description: Student uses digital tools to analyze large data sets for patterns and trends.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student constructs and revises an explanation based on a variety of sources (investigations, models, simulations) and applies scientific principles to solve a design problem, considering unanticipated effects.

Meets Expectations.description: Student makes a quantitative claim regarding the relationship between dependent and independent variables, based on valid and reliable evidence.

Approaching.description: Student constructs an explanation that includes quantitative relationships between variables to describe a phenomenon.

Developing.description: Student applies scientific ideas to construct a simple, evidence-based explanation for a real-world event.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student respectfully provides critiques on scientific arguments by probing reasoning and evidence, challenging conclusions, and determining what additional information is required to resolve contradictions.

Meets Expectations.description: Student evaluates the claims, evidence, and reasoning behind currently accepted explanations or solutions to determine the merits of an argument.

Approaching.description: Student presents a written or oral argument supported by empirical evidence and scientific reasoning to support or refute an explanation.

Developing.description: Student constructs a simple argument with evidence to support a claim.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student compares, integrates, and evaluates sources of information presented in different media (e.g., visually, quantitatively, textually) to solve a complex problem.

Meets Expectations.description: Student communicates scientific or technical information about a complex phenomenon in multiple formats (e.g., orally, graphically, textually, mathematically).

Approaching.description: Student gathers, reads, and synthesizes information from multiple appropriate sources to describe how they are supported by evidence.

Developing.description: Student critically reads scientific texts to determine the central ideas and obtain technical information.

Exceeds Expectations.description: Student consistently takes initiative, seeks out feedback to improve their work, and actively helps create a collaborative and positive learning environment.

Meets Expectations.description: Student is consistently prepared for class, completes assignments on time, and actively participates in class discussions and group work.

Approaching.description: Student is usually prepared for class and completes most assignments. Participates when prompted in class activities.

Developing.description: Student often needs reminders to stay on task, complete assignments, or participate in class activities.
